blocks.text: Condo buildings in Neilsen Grove

Spelling, kept exact throughout: the AREA is "Neilsen Grove"; the SCHOOL is "Neilson Grove Elementary" — School District 37 spells the school "Neilson Grove Elementary" on its own site, at 5500 Admiral Boulevard. The sub-area sits on and around the Marina Garden Estates lands named in City of Delta council reports, under the Delta Official Community Plan, Bylaw No. 8400 (2024).
Pilothouse at Hampton Cove — 5535 Admiral Way

The sub-area's defining condo building: a boutique waterfront apartment building by Polygon Homes in the master-planned Hampton Cove community, between a marina and a golf course. One project profile records 94 residences across four storeys, from studios to three bedrooms, built in 2020; a Polygon project report in the building-directory press records 87 one-, two- and three-bedroom apartments.
Shorewalk — 4955 River Road

An older waterfront condo building at the west edge of the sub-area: a penthouse listing describes a condo in Shorewalk, built in 1991, with 2 parking and 1 storage locker for that unit, underground and visitor parking, elevator, and a building that "has been rainscreened and just got a new roof (2025)" — listing-stated, confirm the roof and envelope work in the depreciation report and minutes.
Streets, schools and getting around Neilsen Grove

items.t: The sub-area is the harbour-side pocket of north Ladner: Admiral Way and Admiral Boulevard are its spine, with Neilson Grove Elementary at 5500 Admiral Boulevard and Ladner Harbour Park at 4905 McNeelys Way serving this shore of Ladner.

"Hampton Cove" and "Marina Garden Estates" are the development names used on City and developer material for this pocket — most of the strata stock here was built as one master-planned waterfront community between a marina and a golf course.

Where the condo stock actually concentrates: there is exactly one apartment-condo building pattern here — Pilothouse on Admiral Way in Hampton Cove, plus the older Shorewalk building on River Road at the sub-area's west edge. Everything else strata in Neilsen Grove is townhouses. A City memorandum on the Marina Garden Estates application also describes a multi-family apartment building within that application, with no street address in the City source.

Transit: TransLink route 618, the Ladner North loop from Ladner Exchange, runs through the area via Ferry Road to Commodore Drive and returns via Admiral Way, Admiral Boulevard, Westminster Avenue, Crescent Drive and 57 Street; route 601 runs from South Delta to Bridgeport Station (Canada Line), stopping at Ladner Exchange.

blocks.text: Local rules that affect condo buyers in Neilsen Grove

items.t: New-home warranty is still running on the newest stock: Strata records for Fairwinds note the structural warranty runs to 2027 under BC's 2-5-10 new-home warranty — the same check applies to Pilothouse and the 2023–24 Westhampton homes: ask which warranty years remain on the specific building.

Delta zoning: Zoning Bylaw No. 7600: Zoning is parcel-by-parcel under Bylaw No. 7600; the Hampton Cove lands were built under site-specific comprehensive development zoning (a Westhampton listing records zoning CD430 for that complex), so each complex's zone and rules are read off its own CD zone and the City zoning maps.

GST on new construction only: Resale condos and townhouses here carry no GST. On a new home, the first-time home buyers' GST/HST rebate (Bill C-4, Royal Assent March 13, 2026, per CRA) rebates 100% of the GST up to $1 million (maximum $50,000), phasing out to $1.5 million; the older GST New Housing Rebate is 36% of the GST, maximum $6,300, phasing out between $350,000 and $450,000.

blocks.text: Good to know about Neilsen Grove

items.t: Hampton Cove was planned as roughly 670 homes, mostly townhouses — Pilothouse is the exception. Project reporting on Beaufort Landing records Hampton Cove at some 670 residences, primarily townhomes, in five phases between a golf course and a marina, and describes Pilothouse as the community's only apartment building. Condo supply in Neilsen Grove is one building deep.
A City memorandum describes a multi-family apartment building within the Marina Garden Estates application, with no street address in the City source.

The warranty clock is a live value item here. With Fairwinds' structural warranty recorded as running to 2027 and Westhampton homes built in 2023–2024, two otherwise similar Hampton Cove purchases can carry very different remaining 2-5-10 warranty coverage — check the building's warranty dates before comparing prices.

The spelling split trips up searches and contracts. The area is "Neilsen Grove" and the school is "Neilson Grove Elementary" — both spellings are in official use, for different things, and a search run under only one spelling will miss listings filed under the other.
There is no Neilsen Grove market data in the standard stats pack.

Spelling lock, kept exact throughout: the AREA is "Neilsen Grove"; the SCHOOL is "Neilson Grove Elementary" — School District 37 spells the school "Neilson Grove Elementary" on its own site, at 5500 Admiral Boulevard. Fairwinds — 5550 Admiral Way. Freehold strata

Strata records compiled from MLS and public strata records record 148 homes in 3 storeys, built 2017, wood frame, freehold strata, strata plan EPS3830, managed by Wynford Group, rentals allowed; the same records note the structural warranty runs to 2027 under BC's 2-5-10 new-home warranty.
Beaufort Landing — 5551 Admiral Way. Strata

124 three- and four-bedroom townhomes by Polygon Beaufort Landing Ltd., the third of five Hampton Cove phases per the project report; Hampton Cove as a whole was planned at roughly 670 residences, primarily townhomes.
Charterhouse — 5510 Admiral Way. Freehold strata
Polygon townhomes; a listing records a riverside 4-bed townhouse in Charterhouse built in 2016, freehold strata, beside the golf course.
Westhampton — 5311 Admiral Way. Strata

Polygon townhomes on the Marina Garden Estates lands (the address named as a townhouse development in a City of Delta council report); listings record townhouse homes built in the 2023–2024 period, listing sub-type Strata, with access to the 12,000 sq ft Hampton Club.
Woodward Landing — 5300 Admiral Way. Strata

Listings record townhomes built in 2006, sub-type Townhouse / Row-Townhouse, with strata-style amenities on the listing record (clubhouse, exercise centre, maintenance grounds, management) and listing text describing the complex as pet-friendly, steps to The Links at Hampton Cove, the marina and walking trails.
Chesapeake Landing — 5900 Ferry Road. Freehold strata

A townhouse / duplex-style complex; listings record Title to Land: Freehold Strata, homes built in 1998–2001 across the complex's phases (different units carry different build years), with clubhouse, pool and guest suites.

items.t: Where the townhouse stock actually concentrates: Admiral Way — five of the six known complexes front it — plus Chesapeake Landing on Ferry Road at the pocket's south edge.

GST on new construction only: Resale townhouses here carry no GST. On a new home, the first-time home buyers' GST/HST rebate (Bill C-4, Royal Assent March 13, 2026, per CRA) rebates 100% of the GST up to $1 million (maximum $50,000), phasing out to $1.5 million, for agreements on or after March 20, 2025 and before 2031; the older GST New Housing Rebate is 36% of the GST, maximum $6,300, phasing out between $350,000 and $450,000.

items.t: Hampton Cove was planned as roughly 670 homes, mostly townhouses — the condos are the exception. Project reporting records Hampton Cove at some 670 residences, primarily townhomes, in five phases between a golf course and a marina, and describes Pilothouse as the community's only apartment building. Neilsen Grove is a townhouse sub-area with one condo building, not the reverse.

The build years span 27 years inside one community name. Chesapeake Landing's phases date to 1998–2001 and Woodward Landing to 2006, while Westhampton homes were built in 2023–2024 — two "Hampton Cove / Marina Garden Estates" townhouses can be a generation apart in envelope, warranty and depreciation-report terms. Compare the complex, not the community name.

blocks.text: Lots and land in Neilsen Grove

Spelling lock, kept exact throughout: the AREA is "Neilsen Grove"; the SCHOOL is "Neilson Grove Elementary" — School District 37 spells the school "Neilson Grove Elementary" on its own site, at 5500 Admiral Boulevard. MLS listing cards using "Neilson Grove" for the AREA are feed text, not the area name.
What trades here

items.t: Fee-simple lots — the default form: The detached stock sits on fee-simple lots under the Delta single-detached residential zones; zoning is assigned parcel by parcel on the zoning maps. A fee-simple lot carries no strata, no Form B and no strata fees — municipal rules plus any registered covenants on title govern instead.

Lot character, only: the subdivision minimums frame the pattern — RS5 at 550 m² (or 460 m² outside the SFR designation; width 16 m or 15 m; depth 30 m), RS6 at 390 m² (width 13 m, depth 30 m), RS7 at 335 m² (width 11 m), duplex zones RD1 at 836 m² (width 22 m, depth 30 m) and RD4 at 504 m² (width 18 m, depth 28 m), while RS1, RS2, RS3, RD2 and RD3 sit at 4,000 m² in lower-density areas; there is no RD5 zone. These are minimums for creating a lot, not a claim about any individual parcel.
The Hampton Cove / Marina Garden Estates lands are built-out strata community land, not bare land
ALR vs non-ALR split: Check any edge parcel on the ALC maps by PID or civic address before pricing farm or subdivision value into it.
Land assemblies / development sites

blocks.text: Streets, schools and getting around Neilsen Grove

items.t: Municipality: Ladner, in the City of Delta, BC. Ladner is one of Delta's three communities (Ladner, Tsawwassen and North Delta); Ladner and Tsawwassen together are called South Delta.

The pocket's spine is Admiral Way and Admiral Boulevard, with Neilson Grove Elementary at 5500 Admiral Boulevard and Ladner Harbour Park at 4905 McNeelys Way serving this shore of Ladner. Nearby areas: Hawthorne to the south, Delta Manor and the Ladner village core to the southwest, Ladner Harbour to the west.
Schools: SD37 catchments are address-based and checked in the SD37 School Locator (Baragar); Delta runs elementary K–7 and secondary 8–12, with no middle-school tier.

Civic anchors: Ladner Leisure Centre, 4600 Clarence Taylor Crescent; Ladner Pioneer Library (Fraser Valley Regional Library), 4683 51st Street; Delta Hospital, 5800 Mountain View Blvd, beside Ladner Exchange, Fraser Health's community hospital for Delta with 24/7 emergency care.

Neilsen Grove is in South Delta (Ladner side), and SnapStats has no coverage for South Delta — the SnapStats FVR September 2026 report contains no Ladner community section and no Neilsen Grove row, and its only Delta coverage is North Delta, which is never presented as a Neilsen Grove or Ladner figure.

blocks.text: Local rules that affect land buyers in Neilsen Grove

items.t: Zoning / subdivision minimums (zone sheets, as the City states them): RS5 550 m² (460 m² outside the SFR designation), RS6 390 m², RS7 335 m², RD1 duplex 836 m², RD4 duplex 504 m²; RS1, RS2, RS3, RD2 and RD3 at 4,000 m² in lower-density areas; no RD5 zone. The RS1 zone also lists a secondary suite as an accessory use to a single detached dwelling.

Form B first — under Strata Property Act s. 59 the Form B Information Certificate discloses the lot's monthly strata fees, amounts owed, approved special levies still to be paid, the CRF balance, parking/storage and a summary of the strata's insurance, with rules, current budget and most recent depreciation report attached; the strata must provide it within 7 days, maximum $35 plus up to 25¢/page. Since July 1, 2024 every strata with five or more lots must obtain a depreciation report every five years. Since November 1, 2023 the annual budget must contribute at least 10% of the operating fund to the CRF. Rental-restriction bylaws have been void since November 24, 2022 for long-term rentals. Only 55+ age bylaws are valid (SPA ss. 123.1/123.2, with exemptions expanded May 1, 2023) — the rule that makes South Pointe's known 55+ position lawful; a "45+" listing line is not a valid age bylaw.

ALR rules: ALR residences cannot be stratified (ALC Bulletin 09 s. 6; Strata Property Act s. 239; Agricultural Land Commission Act s. 21(1)); subdivision within the ALR requires ALC approval. ALC residence caps: principal residence ≤500 m², a suite within the principal residence only, and an additional residence of 90 m² (parcels ≤40 ha) / 186 m² (>40 ha).

Flood / streamside diligence: Ladner is low land protected by the City's flood protection system — over 63 kilometres of dikes, seawalls and foreshore protection, 31 drainage pump stations and approximately 538 kilometres of drainage infrastructure. All properties in Delta within 30 m of a stream, including sloughs and ditches, fall within the Streamside Protection and Enhancement Development Permit Area.

blocks.text: Mobile and manufactured homes in Neilsen Grove
The parks and communities

items.t: South Pointe: A gated community of detached single-level ranchers on their own bare-land strata lots, homes built in 1989. Plainly: a bare-land strata lot is strata tenure — the buyer owns the strata lot and the house on it, pays strata fees for common property (gates, internal roads, common landscaping), and diligence runs through the Form B, the registered bylaws and the depreciation report, exactly as for any strata purchase. It is not a rented pad, and the Manufactured Home Park Tenancy Act does not govern it.

South Pointe: listings from different years record a bare-land strata fee of $113/mo (5359 Jibset Bay listing) and $173/mo (5379 Regatta Way listing data). Both are DATED listing figures, neither is current, and neither is a pad rent — the current fee and what it covers come from the Form B and the strata's financial statements.
Homes on own fee-simple lots: the rest of the sub-area's stock is freehold detached houses under the RS zones (zoning minimums RS5 550/460 m², RS6 390 m², RS7 335 m², RD1 836 m², RD4 504 m²).

blocks.text: Streets, schools and getting around Neilsen Grove

items.t: The sub-area sits on and around the Marina Garden Estates lands named in City of Delta council reports, under the Delta Official Community Plan, Bylaw No. 8400.

Spine streets: Admiral Boulevard and Admiral Way, with Westminster Avenue, Ferry Road and Ladner Trunk Road (Highway 10) named on TransLink's route 618 loop through the pocket; route 618 is the Ladner North loop from Ladner Exchange, and route 601 runs South Delta to Bridgeport Station via Ladner Exchange, Ladner Trunk Road, Highway 17A and Highway 99.

Nearby areas: Hawthorne to the south, Delta Manor and the Ladner village core to the southwest, Ladner Harbour to the west. Ladner Harbour Park, 4905 McNeelys Way, is the City-listed park serving this shore; Ladner Leisure Centre (4600 Clarence Taylor Crescent), Ladner Pioneer Library (4683 51st Street) and Delta Hospital (5800 Mountain View Blvd, 24/7 emergency, beside Ladner Exchange) serve the sub-area.

Low-land context: Ladner is protected by the City's flood protection system — over 63 kilometres of dikes, seawalls and foreshore protection, 31 drainage pump stations and approximately 538 kilometres of drainage infrastructure — and all properties in Delta within 30 m of a stream, including sloughs and ditches, fall within the Streamside Protection and Enhancement Development Permit Area.

blocks.text: Local rules that affect park-home buyers in Neilsen Grove

items.t: Age-restricted parks: in a designated 55-plus park, at least one tenant on the site must be 55 years of age or older. No specific Delta park's age rule is stated from this general rule — a park's own rule is read from its operator / tenancy documents.

City frame — Delta: OCP = Official Community Plan Bylaw No. 8400, consolidated 2024 ("Housing Our Future"). Zoning is assigned parcel by parcel on the zoning maps; zone sheets cite Zoning Bylaw No. 7600, 2017, and South Pointe's own zone is the site-specific CD98A. SSMUH amendments are Bylaws 8394 + 8395 (June 24, 2024), allowing combinations of single detached dwellings, duplex dwellings, secondary suites, coach houses and garden suites where the zoning applies; the RS1 zone also lists a secondary suite as an accessory use. SSMUH does not apply to pad tenancies — it is a land-zoning regime for owned lots, and inside a bare-land strata the strata bylaws sit on top of the zoning.

blocks.text: Good to know about Neilsen Grove

items.t: AREA = "Neilsen Grove"; SCHOOL = "Neilson Grove Elementary" — both spellings are in official use, for different things, so a search run under only one spelling misses stock filed under the other.

South Pointe's two fee figures are both stale, and neither is a pad rent: $113/mo and $173/mo appear in listings from different years for the same bare-land strata — anyone quoting a South Pointe fee without a date is quoting a stale number, and anyone calling it "pad rent" has the tenure wrong; the Form B governs.
Delta's bylaw numbers are a minefield on this area: What governs a lot in practice is its own zone sheet (CD98A at South Pointe) and, for a strata lot, its registered bylaws.

The marsh-edge setting cuts both ways at South Pointe: The community sits at the marsh and waterway edge off Ferry Road: all Delta properties within 30 m of a stream, slough or ditch are in the Streamside Protection and Enhancement Development Permit Area, and Ladner is dike-protected low land — check DeltaMap and title for streamside and flood covenants on the specific lot before subjects.

faq.a: Project reporting says Polygon designed it with downsizers in mind. If age restriction matters to you, read the bylaws in the Form B package, not the marketing.

A waterfront building plus shared access to the Hampton Club — listings describe a 12,000 sq ft clubhouse with outdoor pool, hot tub, fitness centre, lounge and guest suites serving the Hampton Cove community. What your unit's fee actually includes is stated in the strata budget attached to the Form B; do not assume club access is free or mandatory without reading it.
faq.q: What do Pilothouse fees have to cover that a normal condo's don't?

faq.a: The community sits between a marina and a golf course, and listings name Captain's Cove Marina among the nearby amenities. Treat marina access as a separate arrangement unless the Form B or title says otherwise.
faq.q: Can I keep a boat here?

faq.a: A listing states "Pets ok (2)" and the Hampton Cove townhouse listings also describe pet-friendly complexes. Pet bylaws are strata-specific — confirm number and any size limits in the registered bylaws.

For long-term rentals, BC law voids strata rental-restriction bylaws as of Nov 24, 2022 — Fairwinds' strata records already record rentals allowed. Short-term rentals can still be restricted by bylaw.
faq.q: Can I rent out my unit?

faq.a: Strata. Fairwinds and Chesapeake Landing are expressly recorded as freehold strata, Charterhouse listings record freehold strata, and Westhampton listings carry a Strata sub-type — there is no known fee-simple townhouse complex in Neilsen Grove. "Freehold strata" still means strata fees, bylaws, a Form B and a depreciation report; it is not fee-simple ownership.
faq.q: Are Hampton Cove townhouses strata or fee-simple?

faq.a: A waterfront community plus shared access to the Hampton Club — listings describe a 12,000 sq ft clubhouse with outdoor pool, hot tub, fitness centre, lounge and guest suites serving Hampton Cove. What your unit's fee actually includes is stated in the strata budget attached to the Form B.
faq.q: What do the fees have to cover that a normal townhouse complex's don't?

faq.a: None that I know of. The park-form community here is South Pointe — a bare-land strata where you own the lot and the house, not a rented pad.
faq.q: Is there a mobile home park in Neilsen Grove where I can buy a home and rent a pad?

faq.a: A gated bare-land strata (plan NWS2528, zoning CD98A, built 1989) of detached single-level ranchers on the Regatta Way / Jibset Bay / Tidewater Bay streets off Ferry Road. You own a strata lot and the house on it, pay strata fees, and get a Form B, registered bylaws and a depreciation report.
faq.q: What exactly is South Pointe, then?

faq.a: The operative wording for your purchase is still the registered bylaw on the Form B; in BC strata only a 55+ age bylaw can be valid (SPA ss.123.1/123.2).

The home only — a chattel. You would rent the pad under the Manufactured Home Park Tenancy Act, the sale would take effect only when registered in the Manufactured Home Registry (Bill of Sale + Notice to Transfer, filed by a lawyer or notary, CSA label attached), and on a resale the existing pad tenancy is assigned to you on the same terms with the park owner's written consent — requested on RTB Form 10, answered by the 10th day or deemed given, with no consent fee.

faq.a: The area is "Neilsen Grove"; the school is "Neilson Grove Elementary" (5500 Admiral Blvd). Both spellings are in official use, for different things; a search run under only one spelling will miss records filed under the other.
